scope: Supplementary actual desktop Chrome on isolated Linux Nginx/local HTTP, controlled API, 390x844 DPR3. External fonts blocked with CDP; native HTTP cache retained. No phone/HTTPS/real audio/low-device target/pre-change comparison or Q201 selection claim.
